story:
[emotion:QT/afraid] Ethan ran through the living room because his red superhero cape had disappeared before the big team mission. He checked behind the couch, then under three chairs, but the cape was nowhere.

"I think it fell in my room," said his friend Rosa, who had been visiting all afternoon. "We were playing there earlier, remember?[emotion:QT/angry] "

Ethan felt frustrated, although he tried not to show it. Rosa saw his face and understood right away.

[emotion:QT/happy] "Let's search together," Rosa said cheerfully. "I'll check the tall shelves while you look inside the round basket."

After a few minutes, Rosa reached into a deep, cozy corner behind her backpack and pulled out the bright red cape.

[emotion:QT/happy] "You found it!" Ethan shouted, grabbing Rosa in a grateful hug. [gesture:kiss] Rosa laughed. [emotion:QT/happy] "That's what teammates are for.[gesture:stretching] "

Ethan threw the cape over his shoulders, and they charged down the hallway together, ready to save the day. [emotion:QT/happy]

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his superhero cape?
questions.correct_answer: Real teammates help each other through challenges
wrong_answers: Superheroes should never lose their capes
Children should keep their rooms tidy

questions.question: Where did Rosa reach in to find the bright red superhero cape?
questions.correct_answer: A deep corner behind her backpack
wrong_answers: Under three chairs in the living room
On the tall shelves in the room

questions.question: After Ethan checked behind the couch, what three things did he do before Rosa helped him search?
questions.correct_answer: He checked under three chairs and then felt frustrated
wrong_answers: He ran outside and then called for Rosa
He checked the round basket and then the tall shelves

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan grabbed Rosa in a grateful hug when she found the red cape?
questions.correct_answer: Because he was relieved and thankful she rescued his cape
wrong_answers: Because he thought Rosa had hidden the cape on purpose
Because the team mission was already finished

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Rosa had not been there to help Ethan search for his superhero cape?
questions.correct_answer: Ethan might have missed the big team mission without his cape
wrong_answers: Ethan would have found three more capes in the round basket
Rosa would have charged through the hallway without him

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan and Rosa to search for the cape together?
questions.correct_answer: Working together with a friend helps you solve problems faster.
wrong_answers: Letting one person do all the searching means the job gets done more carefully.
Solving problems on your own builds stronger skills than asking for help.

questions.question: What did Ethan show us by what he did when Rosa offered to help him find the cape?
questions.correct_answer: Asking a friend for help shows you trust them.
wrong_answers: Letting a friend help you means you don't have to try hard yourself.
Accepting help from others means you should return the favor right away.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story about how Ethan and Rosa worked as a team?
questions.correct_answer: Real teamwork means taking turns and listening to each other.
wrong_answers: Good teammates always agree on the same plan before starting any task.
The best way to help a friend is to do the hardest part of the job for them.

takeaways: Working together with a friend helps you solve problems faster.
Asking a friend for help shows you trust them.
Real teamwork means taking turns and listening to each other.
